markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: define codified and uncodified constitutions; present arguments for codification (clear rights, limits on power, citizen reference point, modern democratic standard); present arguments against (flexibility loss, difficult to agree, judicial activism risk, UK system works well); evaluate using international comparisons (USA, Germany have codified constitutions); conclude: a codified constitution would strengthen rights protection and democratic accountability, but the current system's flexibility is valuable. A compromise might be a written constitution that preserves some flexibility through amendment procedures.
